notes.title: Release Date Announced!
notes.content:
[h1][b]Hey Deconstructors! 👋 [/b] [/h1]

[h2]We are extremely excited to announce something that you have awaited for a long time! 🔥[/h2]

[h1][b]Deconstruction Simulator releases on September 23, 2025! 🎉[/b][/h1]

https://store.steampowered.com/app/2487150/Deconstruction_Simulator

[previewyoutube=JrqZYxbvQDE;full][/previewyoutube]

After months of development, of communicating with you, ensuring every screw, every part is in the right place we are ready to show the full version of what we assembled for you! 🫵

[b]Everything we build will be for you to DESTROY! ⚒️[/b]

[h3][b]What you can expect in the upcoming full version?[/b][/h3]
[list][*] Over [b]40 of different contracts[/b] and maps, each of them made by hand, unique and beautiful!
[*] Complete destruction system where you can [b]destroy the whole house[/b] right into the fundamentals!
[*] [b]Improve your company in various ways[/b], from tools, to your own warehouse and vehicles in a satisfying progression loop!

Join us on our Discord server to share all the excitement about the full release ! 💬

notes.title: Knock Knock
notes.content:
[h1][b]Hello there, deconstruction specialists! 👋[/b][/h1]

With this devlog, we're gonna focus on something that we believe you'll appreciate. We don't want Deconstruction Simulator to be repetitive, where everytime you'll start, you will handle the same requests, the same places.
That is why we want today to focus on our variety of houses! 🏠

[h3]Deconstruction Simulator features dozens of different houses. Each one is unique and handcrafted by our team to bring you the most fun and personality. [/h3]

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44337691/8c78c1aac79376e4045c3f8fb61f2482ad326484.jpg[/img]
Everyday the environment will be different around you, quiet suburbs, city center, or lush forests with a single hut are just some of them. 🏞️

[h3]You will venture from simple, small trailer houses to glamorous, modern mansions filled with plenty of elements![/h3] Each of them can be dismantled down to their foundations, even if you want to go against the client's request and receive a penalty. This brings a need to have a different strategy for each home, but you will always have [b]Relaxed mode [/b]to go from deconstruction to complete destruction! 💥

All of those you will slowly unlock through [b]tiers[/b]. Each tier unlocks a different type of house that will require a completely new strategy for their deconstruction challenges. 
While you will start from a simple trailer house, it will quickly go up in scale and complexity.


[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44337691/f19c9127a0a5c2d47f3913f7bd2615798a7f5e75.jpg[/img]
As you are out there in the field, you can take a look around.  Every house tells a story, including its owner's, and with a keen eye you can find out plenty of clues about who you work for. 
It may be an average Silverhollow resident with a family, but some of them may be famous artists or shady politicians. 👨‍🎨 
Each house has a great amount of quirks, showing the personality of the owner.
You will see the ongoing stories of your clients, but also those that ended.

While playing the game you will find ruined houses that will require a different approach from what you will usually do! 🏚️
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44337691/a5d5e9c4003ee9bc9f22d7402e03893cf137d5a3.jpg[/img]
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44337691/7a7bbc5060ef42bf2444d69d6806f255699392a8.jpg[/img]


That's it for now, thank you for reading in, and look out for more devlogs, as each of them gets us closer and closer to the full release!
To be on par with all the news check out our official discord! 💬
[url=https://discord.gg/Dw8PG93s4z][img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44337691/1c96a12b016c0e622e7018d3024bcc232154d68f.png[/img][/url]

See you soon,
Deconstruction Simulator Team!

notes.title: 🚧 Demo Update is Live! 🚧
notes.content:
Hey everyone!

We’ve just released a new update for the Deconstruction Simulator demo - a small hotfix that addresses a few key issues reported by players.

Thanks so much for playing and sharing your feedback! 🙌

[u][b]Patch notes :[/b][/u]

[list]
[*] We have fixed an issue where a contract requiring the demolition of a house required the destruction of all objects in the house. Now, the game does not require you to find every single item to complete the task. We have also changed the task progress display from numbers to percentages.
[*] We have fixed a bug that caused some furniture to disappear from maps after leaving and returning to the contract location.
[*] We have fixed an issue that could cause players to get stuck in the tutorial due to insufficient debris to collect .
[*] Translations for all languages have been improved.
[/list]


See you soon
Deconstruction Simulator Team

notes.title: NEW DEMO UPDATE OUT NOW!
notes.content:
[h1]Hello there, Deconstructors! 👋[/h1]

We talked about a bunch of improvements in our previous devlogs, new contracts, new mechanics, new modes. All those exciting aspects, but no way to try them out...

[h3][b]Until today! 👇[/b][/h3]

https://store.steampowered.com/app/2765650/Deconstruction_Simulator_Demo

We have released  the new version of the Demo [b]RIGHT NOW[/b], with a magnificent amount of improvements, many of which were mentioned in our devlogs.
Well no point in keeping your restless hammers waiting.

[h3][b]Here are the patch notes![/b] [/h3]
[list]
[b][*] Exciting new contracts, including a contract for a multi-story house. 🏚️
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44337691/86ebc4335d0ed4ab229b08c49011314bc7e8a1b4.jpg[/img]
[*] Two game modes: Relaxed and Standard. The first allows players to play without penalties and with fewer time limits, while the second is the intended Deconstruction Simulator experience, with all its challenges. ⚙️

[*] Two furniture dismantling modes: Simplified and Standard. Simplified makes dismantling faster and less complicated. You can change it in the game settings. 🧰

[*] Access to a wrecking ball. One of the contracts allows you to see how the wrecking ball control system works. 🏗️

[*] Improved demolition. The hammer has become more precise, and the new sound effects make destruction extremely satisfying. 🔨

[*] Even more interesting house interiors. Every house in the game has gained a LOT of detail, which you can get a taste of in the demo. 🏡[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44337691/1bb1e3abda6ff0dc27093fb95efd8118012f87cc.jpg[/img]

[*] Improved visuals. Deconstruction Simulator looks even better than before. 👀

[*] Improved optimization. The game runs noticeably better than Prologue, especially on less powerful devices. 🎞️

[*] Significant changes to gameplay balance. Both contracts and orders have been better adapted to player expectations, providing a more satisfying deconstruction. 🤑

[*] A whole host of fixes and improvements over the prologue. We've fixed hundreds of bugs and rebuilt several systems to ensure a smooth and enjoyable experience. 🛠️[/b]
[/list]
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44337691/7005162a51b7b95a9b7192174caa84251dd6dc9e.jpg[/img]
For now, Deconstruction Simulator Demo is the latest and most refined version of the game available. If you want the best experience, this is the one to play.

To get yourself hyped, check out our  demo trailer! 👇
[previewyoutube=mRhSryDpysY;full][/previewyoutube]

All of your feedback helped us immensely in creating this update and in realizing our focus with Deconstruction Simulator! 💬

A bunch of your voices came from our official Discord, so how about joining us? 😎

[url=https://discord.gg/Dw8PG93s4z][img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44337691/1c96a12b016c0e622e7018d3024bcc232154d68f.png[/img][/url]


See you out in the field!
Deconstruction Simulator Team

notes.title: Easier and Smoother
notes.content:
[b][h1]HELLO DECONSTRUCTORS 👋[/h1] [/b]

[h3][b]Welcome back to another devlog, where we have exciting things to announce🔥[/b][/h3]

First of all, we want to [b]THANK YOU[/b] for trying out the Prologue version of the game and giving us all the feedback we needed! Your comments and discussion brought light to things we need to add, fix, adjust, to make your experience the best there is. 

And this is what this devlog will ultimately be about, the community's feelings about the Prologue. We read your suggestions, we watched your youtube videos, we looked upon your comments, reviews  and  various labors of love. Most of the points included are based on what you shared and what we wanted to do to make your lives easier. So this devlog and contents are just as much a product of [b]your work[/b] and passion as ours. 💞

[b]LET'S GET[/b] to it so you can continue your deconstruction [b]ASAP![/b] 🔨
 
[h3][b]🔧 Quality of Life[/b][/h3]
[list]
[*][b]Added FOV settings.[/b]
[*][b]Improvements on game performance[/b] - game should be smoother and quicker to load.
[*] [b]Improved Item Placing System:[/b]
[list]
[*]More freedom during furniture placement.
[*] Better collision detection and automatic adjustment to environment.
[*] [b]Overall it is now much more responsive and easier to use.[/b]
[/list]
[*] [b]New Contract Interface! 🗒️[/b] - Accepted contracts are now always on top, also it's easier to browse through assignments.
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44337691/08ec531103d5ead78f9d684e941d53ea223215ca.png[/img]
[*][b]Full Controller Support 🎮[/b] - with improved item placement.
[*] [b]New Starting Car[/b] - It's bigger to fill, it's prettier, it's easer to use.
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44337691/fc1491c0f2b7384354de2f44fbdb2dd5a403c258.png[/img]
[h3][b] 💵  Balance and Economy[/b][/h3]
You wanted [b]MORE DESTRUCTION[/b] - So we give it to you!
[list]
[*][b]Lesser Punishments[/b]- Creative destruction now has lesser negative impact on your contract. [b]Go Crazy![/b]
[*] [b]Better Economy[/b]- We work [b]HARD[/b] and we play [b]HARDER[/b]. Better balance of costs, contract payouts and rewards. Less grind and more fun.
[*] [b]New Contract Randomisation System[/b] - More variety, and friendlier, more exciting missions.
[/list]
[url=https://discord.gg/Dw8PG93s4z][img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44337691/1c96a12b016c0e622e7018d3024bcc232154d68f.png[/img][/url]
[h3][b]This is all for now,[/b][/h3] but this not the end. I assure you that more contracts of [b]TOTAL DESTRUCTION[/b] are just around the corner! 🧰

notes.title: PROLOGUE | Upcoming updates + about AI VO
notes.content:
[h2][b]Dear Deconstructors,[/b][/h2]

[h3][b]We would like to thank our entire community for the warm welcome to yesterday's release of the free Deconstruction Simulator: Prologue. Your support and enthusiasm are extremely motivating for us! 🤝[/b][/h3]

[h3]Special thanks to all the Steam reviews and suggestions we have received from you. Every feedback is extremely important to us, as it helps us improve the game and meet your expectations for the full version of the game. 🙌[/h3]

https://store.steampowered.com/app/2778430/Deconstruction_Simulator_Prologue/

[b]🚧 [u]About AI VO[/u][/b]
We would also like to address a matter that many of you have raised - the use of AI VO. In our free Prologue, we have used AI VO. However, we realize that we did not communicate this clearly enough on Steam page. We would like to point out that AI VO was [b]only used temporarily in the free Prologue version[/b].

We believe that working with real artists is important for both our game and the industry as a whole. We assure you that the voices of the characters in the full version of the game are created with real human talent behind the microphone.

[b]🚧 [u]Upcoming updates[/u][/b]
Additionally, we would like to inform you that the first update to Prologue will be released soon, which will fix bugs and include game improvements.

The updates will include the quality of life features you've been asking for, including mouse invert, FOV slider and many other important changes.

What's more, we will also disable the penalty system in the Prologue so that you can get a stress-free look at the content we have prepared for you. 

We also confirm that the Full Version of the game will include two modes: with and without penalties system. Thus, everyone will be able to customize the experience to their own preferences.



If you haven't had a chance to share your feedback yet, we highly encourage you to leave an opinion on Steam or visit our Discord server, where you can talk to members of our team.

Thank you once again for your support and contribution to the development of the game!
Deconstruction Simulator Team

notes.title: The Wrecking Ball
notes.content:
[h1][b]Hello Players! 👋[/b][/h1]

[h3]Welcome to the new devlog! Today we’d like to show you another tool at your disposal. One which can become extremely valuable help, or bring you a lose depending on how you use it- [b]the wrecking ball 💣[/b].[/h3]

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44337691/e5e732cf45e84ee22098a0b4b0ed249c6cbeb29e.png[/img]
In the prologue, players will get an early introduction to the wrecking ball. While they won’t have full control over it at this stage, they will be able to use it in a limited capacity. This early experience serves as a preview of its potential, allowing players to get a feel for its destructive power before they can fully utilize it later in the game. 📝

The wrecking ball is not a tool that players have constant access to—it must be rented for a fee. 💲 Its primary function is tied to contracts involving derelict buildings, where quick demolition is essential. In some standard contracts, players may also have the option to use the wrecking ball, though it’ll be a rare occurrence. 

[b]We love this tool and it’s super fun to use so we’re positive you’ll love using it as well.[/b] 🤩 But as with many of the fun things in life… use it with caution because too much destruction sometimes leads to a penalty, such as in situation when you demolish structures that should remain intact. 😢

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44337691/5b47afa80e8037ce821a44d380635ec658188621.gif[/img]
[b]The main advantage of using the wrecking ball is efficiency. ⌚[/b] In rundown properties, where the goal is often to clear out the space as quickly as possible to prepare it for resale, the wrecking ball becomes an invaluable tool. 

Instead of manually dismantling structures piece by piece, players can use it to bring down entire buildings and their interiors in a matter of moments. This streamlined approach not only saves time but also enhances the overall flow of the demolition process, making large-scale destruction both satisfying and practical. 👷

[h3]We hope that this introduction piqued your interest and you’ll use this tool during your work! 💪 As always, we’d love to hear your thoughts on the topic so make sure to share them with us in the comments![/h3]

notes.title: Brick System 🧱✨
notes.content:
[h1][b]Hello Deconstructors! 👋[/b][/h1]

[h3]One of the core features of Deconstruction Simulator is our [b]Brick System 🛠️[/b], an essential part of the destruction mechanics. Brick walls are unique in that they consist of the highest number of individual components—bricks! Players can dismantle them in two ways:

[b]Manual Approach 🔍[/b]: Carefully remove mortar and take out bricks one by one.
[b]Smash & Destroy 💥[/b]: Use a hammer to break through the wall for a more action-packed experience.[/h3]

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44337691/c39efebf2597ca633b6a31ac0054f4193ee74b05.jpg[/img]
[h3][b]Why It Matters 🎮[/b][/h3]
Taking down brick walls is one of the tasks players can be assigned during the game. Not only does it yield income 💰, but it also provides bricks 🧱 that can be collected on special pallets 📦 and stored in the warehouse 🏬. These bricks can then be sold for extra cash 💵.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44337691/04ec86bb1bd0dc6bc9b7ac0af1c2b0f9c009a372.jpg[/img]
[h3][b]Upgrades 🚀[/b][/h3]
While the Brick System itself cannot be upgraded, players can expand their warehouse with additional brick racks 🗄️. Additionally, purchasing pallets is crucial for transporting bricks efficiently. 🛒
Stay tuned for more updates, and let us know how you're enjoying dismantling brick by brick! 🏗️

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44337691/591514a6e69aa0f038213d9b387287ca106872ca.jpg[/img]

notes.title: Dismantling and destroying
notes.content:
[h1][b]Hello Deconstructors! 👋[/b][/h1]

[h3]Welcome back to another devlog! Today we’ve got a topic every finest deconstruction is fond of- [b]dismantling and destroying stuff[/b].[/h3]

Some of you may say… [b]“Hey, destroying? Didn’t you already say in the previous devlog that destroyed stuff can’t be resold so it’s basically a waste?”[/b] Technically yes, you’re right. The destroyed stuff turns into debris which can be recycled for some coins albeit much less than what you would get for an item in perfect condition. 💰

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44337691/eda86acce43127542d9b401370d72c178fb50d58.png[/img]
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44337691/187680be3ad8f7bfa41c52a504f1a6c2b4bcc741.png[/img]
[b]“Why would I be doing that if that’s the case?” 🤔[/b] There are few reasons and the most important one is simply… because you can! Not to mention it’s quite fun to just ram into the contracted house and hammer through everything. 👷 It’s also much quicker. ⌚

Some contracts may mention negative consequences for destroying stuff while others will even encourage you to do so. 📝 [b]Accept whichever contracts sound like the most fun to you and enjoy whatever you’re off to do in there, after all it’s your company, isn’t it? 👍[/b]

[previewyoutube=jCOrNTUxO3Q;full][/previewyoutube]

With that being said, there are some fine, expensive items waiting for you during the contracts. When you identify them it’d be wise to proceed carefully. Dismantling stuff requires keen eye, precision and proper tools used in the right moment so make sure to [b]invest in your equipment. Upgrading it will most definitely save you a lot of time. 🧰[/b]

[previewyoutube=6hiWkdawPyc;full][/previewyoutube]

As you can see, even an item simple as a wardrobe takes a moment and a few tools to be successfully taken apart but once you’re done, you’ll be able to take it to your warehouse and resell for great profit! 💲 Every single item you find can be either dismantled or destroyed- it’s up to you to evaluate which action will bring you the most fun and money to grow your business!

We’d love to hear your opinions on this topic so make sure to [b]leave a comment[/b] and let us know your thoughts! You can also [b]join our discord[/b] and have a chat with our dev team! 🤩

[b]If you enjoyed this devlog consider adding the game to your wishlist to not miss out on any upcoming ones![/b]

notes.content:
[h1][b]Hello Fellow Deconstructors! 👋[/b][/h1]

Welcome back to another devlog which will further develop your knowledge about the Deconstruction Simulator basics! 💪 Recently, we’ve been focused on creating many unique models of houses for the contracts. That’s why today we’d like to talk a bit more about contracts and show you some results of our work on new locations! 🤩 [b]Currently lot of our effort is put to make sure that all the details of the locations- be it outside elevations or each element of the interior is up to the standard.[/b]

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44337691/82ef70dff4f7794fc6492ac7e6a027a2da0c6ffa.jpg[/img]
It’s only natural that all the city has different neighborhoods, where housing is developed. In our game we’re introducing 3 separate locations each requiring a certain level of your company’s reputation to be able to take contracts from there. ([b]✨ 1-5 stars rating[/b])

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44337691/9dac36a1b3bd92e96d68c99b83a1c08fb9bda870.jpg[/img]
As for the works commissioned, you can accept the contracts in your office. They can involve different tasks such as bringing out all the furniture, cleaning the place or deconstructing certain elements such as walls etc. ⚒️ Performing actions that aren’t included or are inconsistent with the commission will result in receiving a cash punishment. 😥

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44337691/a8ebde344a9574fa02611479e28d709c015496a3.jpg[/img]
We’ve mentioned the separate locations. Currently these are as follows: [b]the forest, suburbs, city[/b]. 📝 Every house is assigned to a contract, which as we’ve said are available after achieving a certain level of reputation.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44337691/5ee630c74b78acbacf103bfec70ef8d0e05d9174.jpg[/img]
At this point you might wonder-[b] how can we gain reputation[/b]? It’s simple! [b]Complete the accepted contracts to the best of your abilities and the closer to perfection you get, the better scores your company gets[/b]. Although focusing on easier, low star locations might be a good idea to grab some easy money 💰 the high rating houses offer other kinds of findings such as premium goods! It’s up to you to choose the best strategy.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44337691/d8d14826a85215aa8c873f001f4414e31af02ba9.jpg[/img]

notes.title: Warehouse
notes.content:
[h1][b]Hello Deconstructors! 👋 [/b][/h1]

The previous devlogs made you ask us about [b]the warehouse[/b]. 📦 It was a place mentioned on different occasions and today, we’d like to shed some light on its functions and in-game features it offers. Not only it allows you to store the recycled goods but also manage the entire business! 👍

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44337691/60101f301550667440081f9ab497ae842cfb0b5a.png[/img]
It wouldn’t be an exaggeration to say that the warehouse is the beating heart of your business. There are many different things you can do inside so let’s start with what we’ve already mentioned in the truck devlog.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44337691/5c9e4cadaafbb4d2267f9f9259bfabfba2febd41.png[/img]
Once your truck arrives at the warehouse, all the goods and materials you’ve collected have to be unloaded manually. ✋ This means that you’ll have to sort them and find them a suitable place on the shelves. To help you maintain the order inside your warehouse there are indicators showing what’s stored on each particular storage shelf. 😀 It’s a division based on different categories, some of which are:
[b]-furniture
-wood
-plasterboard[/b]

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44337691/0b4f6d3ffcece444d6b45aacdb488cd98909e257.png[/img]
Let’s move to the management part, shall we? Inside the warehouse there is an additional area designated as your office. It’s a place with a simple but smart design which is a perfect workplace for a person running this kind of business. The most important tool at your disposal is the computer. 💻 It provides you with different functions and the most important ones are:
[b]- contract management,
- order management,
- tool store,
- warehouse upgrade system,[/b]

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44337691/ee8b2a1467f692898a3ce8352547f2dd75a49ac5.png[/img]
Although every single one of the aforementioned functions is important, the most vital one to grow your business is undoubtedly the warehouse upgrade system. 💪 It allows you to gain additional space which results in being able to complete bigger orders. Naturally, bigger orders mean more money and the more money you earn, the more you can spend on better contracts to reclaim pricier, better quality materials and furniture. 💰

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44337691/f27d095e0361a1739786e18fb5c6b5d151f14f58.png[/img]
As you can see, it’s a nice system which is easy to understand. It doesn’t mean that you have to go for the biggest tasks as soon as possible. You can make money on every single commission and it’s up to you to find the ones providing you with the most satisfaction and fun in the process. 

Don’t forget to let us know if you like the contents of today’s devlog. If you are interested in more details about the game we encourage you to read the previous devlogs and [b]join our discord community[/b]. You can also [b]add the game to your wishlist[/b] to get a notification about every new devlog, playtest and any other news as soon as it’s published!

notes.title: Furniture dismantling
notes.content:
[h1][b]Hello Players! 👋[/b][/h1]

We’re glad to see you in the third devlog from 🔨 Deconstruction Simulator and today, we’d like to give you a little insight into the [b]furniture dismantling system! 🧰[/b]

As we’ve already mentioned one of the tasks in every place you’ll deconstruct is to dismantle any furniture you might be able to resell later. 💰 In our game you’ll have [b]two possibilities[/b]. You can smash cupboards, refrigerators, tables and other objects with [b]the hammer[/b], or take a more patient approach and use [b]the screwdriver[/b]. 🔩

[h3][b]The first option has one big advantage- you’re saving a lot of time[/b] but at the same time the [b]materials will get damaged or destroyed[/b] which basically means you’ll need to throw everything out and [b]won’t earn a single penny[/b].

If you choose to do it using a screwdriver you’ll have to spend a bit more time and complete a series of minigames some of which you can see in the video below. 👇[/h3]

[previewyoutube=qs3fAMVoLkk;full][/previewyoutube]
[b]Once the task is successfully completed you’ll be able to transport the acquired materials with your truck 🚛 to sell them in the warehouse later on. 

As you can see, [b]safely dismantled furniture is automatically packed into boxes[/b] which can be easily loaded into your vehicle. 

That’s not the end! We do understand that different people would like to focus on different aspects of the game and will enjoy some approaches more than the others. That’s why the abilities connected with dismantling furniture will be given an [b]upgrade system[/b] but we’ll explain this in more detail in the upcoming devlogs! 🤩

We’d love to know your opinions on this aspect of the game. Do you find it interesting? Would you like us to give you more approaches? Let us know in the comments because we can’t wait to hear your ideas! 🙂 As always, we’d like to invite you to [b]join our discord community[/b] 👇 where you can meet other people interested in Deconstruction Simulator!

See you soon,
Deconstruction Simulator Team

notes.title: Truck
notes.content:
[h1][b]Hello Players! 👋[/b][/h1]

We’re happy to have you with us in this new devlog from Deconstruction Simulator! ⚒️ Recently, we’ve been working on different mechanics like dismantling objects which we’ll cover in next devlog. 😀 We’re also working really hard on the looks of both, environmental and each particular object which already yields some impressive results. 

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44337691/cbf86d591d15630770019e2d76dc3994bb0f8c72.png[/img]
[h3]We’d love to give you not only polished mechanics but also eye pleasing graphics allowing you to deconstruct objects and buildings in various sceneries. 🍃[/h3]

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44337691/ffa965711a365b6bc4176059c621daede4084f2c.png[/img]
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44337691/6285fe472363c6530c109ac1c598f60b25798600.png[/img]
We’ll make sure to keep you posted on the topic but today, we’d like to focus on a different aspect of the game- [b]the truck[/b] 🚛 which is one of the most crucial tools at your disposal throughout your entire gameplay. 

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44337691/6ba279bf7947dfd3d7686a04a157ebb52aa6fabe.png[/img]
When you first start your deconstruction adventure you’ll have a single, simple truck that you’ll be able to upgrade using the money you earn. 👍  Every time you work, It’ll be parked outside the building you’re currently deconstructing. 

And as you’ve guessed by this moment, you’ll use the truck to transport the salvaged materials to the warehouses for further management. 📝 Life is not easy though and there’s no magic so you’ll have to load the truck manually. 💪

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44337691/9f0a2ba19a10a8cec05d3317a2c9f206a842f5d1.png[/img]
Once fully packed, the truck will leave with the animation of delivery to your warehouse where you can arrange your newly acquired goods! 💲

The warehouse though, is a topic for a separate devlog which will surely happen soon. 🙂

We’d love to hear your opinions on the scenery and the truck mechanic. If you have any ideas or suggestions about what to improve or what other features you’d like us to add to the game, please let us know on Steam or on the discord! 👇

notes.title: Gameplay conception
notes.content:
[h1][b]Hello Players! 👋[/b][/h1]

[h3] We’d like to welcome all of you in the first devlog from Deconstruction Simulator!🔨[/h3]

Today, we’d like to share the basics behind the game and the player's role in all of this. The game is still in its early stages of development but we’re working tirelessly adding more and more elements of gameplay. 💪 We’ll showcase them in the future. 

In the game, the player will become an owner of a construction company which specializes in recovering and recycling materials from the properties to be demolished. 🧨 [b](The player himself doesn’t demolish the buildings)[/b].

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44337691/f1f2f136574a9d1261d8fa4a60277bf3b106e400.png[/img]
The goal of the game is to obtain building materials and valuable items, store it inside your warehouse and then sell them according to the demand of the market! 💰 Make good market decisions, follow the prices and achieve the best results in order to maximize your profits.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44337691/730240306943f4c1e294d171defdf15219dd9e27.png[/img]
The player has to personally take care of all the activities involved in deconstruction the interior elements. 🧱 Use hammers, pry bar and screwdrivers to raise your efficiency! Before you start your work, you’ll be able to look through the property and estimate the value of items inside. 📝 At this point we’d like to remind you that every mechanic and aspect of the game will be further developed and explained in the future.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44337691/866eb9306d051c2cbfcfbd36646d194a4c988ae7.png[/img]
The gameplay concept revolves around both acquiring items and developing your business. Start as an owner of a small company with only a few basic tools at your disposal to start earning money and work your way up! 👍

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44337691/c7e9448ec61f3929d7771c60ff4886bc92faf12b.png[/img]
Bring down the interior walls and roof to recycle the valuable materials, sort everything and earn some money. 💲💲 [b]Be careful though, materials and items can be damaged and after being destroyed they can’t be sold. Therefore, some caution is greatly appreciated.[/b] 

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44337691/506ab750c0601c5d0dadeffac316ff9b9ccd17f6.png[/img]
You’ll have an entire warehouse at your disposal. Use it to store your collected materials and items. There are different kinds of goods that you can sell. Keep in mind that prices and demand of the market change. Keep the track of those changes and choose the best moment to maximize the value!⏫ 

To answer some of the questions which may have arised: there will be no open world in the game and the levels will be chosen through accepting the commissions. You’ll be able to complete those tasks by meeting different requirements, a certain amount of value, completing certain actions and so on. 🙂

We’re excited to share the development journey with you and we’d like to encourage you to share your suggestions and ideas about the content, UI and possibilities in our game. We can’t wait to hear them in the comments, discussion section and on our discord! 👇 You can also consider adding the game to your wishlist. 
See you in the next devlog.

https://store.steampowered.com/app/2487150/Deconstruction_Simulator/

Deconstruction Simulator Team
